definitions.gloss: training; practice; cultivating skill through repetition
definitions.explanation: Disciplined practice aimed at mastering a skill, especially in martial arts, qigong, and traditional Chinese-influenced physical or spiritual disciplines. Emphasizes the cultivation of inner skill through sustained effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{気功|きこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{練功|れんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I practice qigong training every morning.

examples.japanese: {太極拳|たいきょくけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{練功|れんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{継続|けいぞく}→継続：00213_keizoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。

examples.english: After accumulating practice under my master, I finally internalized the techniques.

notes:
Composed of {練|れん} (to refine, to polish) and {功|こう} (skill, merit, achievement). Borrowed from Chinese {練功|れんこう} (liàngōng). While ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧ is the general word for practice, {練功|れんこう} carries a more disciplined, meditative connotation associated with martial arts and body-mind cultivation traditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {練功|れんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to accumulate practice
- {練功|れんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue training
- {気功|きこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{練功|れんこう}: qigong practice
- {練功|れんこう}{場|じょう}: training ground

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: practice — the general, everyday word for practicing any skill
- ⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧: ascetic training, discipline — training with a spiritual or character-building dimension
- ⟦{鍛錬|たんれん}→鍛錬：08190_tanren⟧: tempering, forging — rigorous physical or mental training to build strength
